procedural_matters: The Technical Committee was represented by Thomas Lösch SWE 713 was represented by Jasper Starley (Tactician of SWE 713) Thomas Lösch (Technical Committee) presentd photographic evidence
facts: After race Nr. 4 the Technical Committee inspected SWE 713.
The stainless strap to fix the keel in a down position was lying near the keel including nuts but was not attached.
The boat admitted to have forgotten it during rigging.
SI 20 states that any penalty for a breach of class rules is discrationaly with a minmum of 10%.
conclusions: By not having the keel fixed with the stainless strap SWE 713 broke CR 8.2 and RRS 78.1.
decision: Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a starting penalty of 20% was decided. The penalty was decreased because there was no competitive advantage and the breach was accidential. The penalty is a 10% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method described in rule 44.3(c) and applied to race number 4, but not worse than DNF.
